'''Coronet Arms''' was an arms manufacturer known for the high quality of its products. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it produced the [[Dueling pistol/Legends|dueling pistol]], [[H-7 "Equalizer" blaster pistol/Legends|H-7 "Equalizer" blaster pistol]] and [[HL-27 light blaster pistol]].
